snippet.textDisplay:
Why everyone saying nothing like Michael but it is Michael’s daughter??????

Edit: for all the people saying she’s not his daughter, you clearly don’t know biology. Skin colour is a polygenic trait meaning it’s influenced by multiple genes as well as the environment. This can cause continuous variation in skin colour causing different combinations of skin tone. Therefore may also be due to recessive traits or hidden ancestry - you don’t know whether Michael Jackson is 100% black he may carry a gene for a lighter skin colour - look at his dad Joseph has blue eyes. So don’t be so quick to say she’s not her daughter
